answer.title: Automated Invoice Generation on Job Completion
answer.trigger: A field worker marks a job as complete in the jobs system.
steps: Detect when a job status changes to complete in the jobs system.
Extract job details, customer information, and line items from the completed job.
Draft a new invoice in the accounts system using the extracted details.
Send the drafted invoice to Emma for review and approval.
answer.ai_help: Extracts job details and line items to automatically draft the correct invoice in the accounts system.
answer.human_approval: Emma must review and approve the draft invoice in the accounts system before it is sent to the customer.
answer.risk_reason: Incorrect invoice amounts or details could lead to billing errors and customer dissatisfaction.
